spanish: Y tomará el sacerdote el brazo cocido desde el carnero, y torta ázima una desde la canasta, y oblea ázima una, y dará sobre palmas del nazir después de afeitarse su nézer.

findings.issue: Common noun הַנָּזִיר is left as the untranslated lemma nazir.
Common noun נִזְרוֹ is left as the untranslated lemma nézer; only the 3ms suffix is rendered (su).
Dual construct כַּפֵּי is an unmarked plural; the two palms are not stated.
Hithpael infinitive with 3ms subject suffix is only afeitarse, so the shaver is unmarked beside the priest as main-clause subject.

notes: Take, priest, boiled arm, from the ram, one unleavened cake, from the basket, one unleavened wafer, give upon, and after are licensed.
